title: ONC (BeOne Medicines) shares_outstanding is a stale/wrong figure fed straight through from yfinance with no cross-check, off by ~8% from the real ADS count and ~14x from the real ordinary-share count
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/ONC -> shares_outstanding = 104271757. The real ADS count derived from the company's own 10-Q cover (1,478,124,405 ordinary shares / 13 per ADS) is 113,701,877 — the app's figure is ~8.3% below that and does not match any of the company's own filed share counts (ordinary shares outstanding 1,478,124,405 as of 2026-07-31, ordinary shares on balance sheet 1,469,278,815 as of 2026-06-30, or ADS-equivalent 113,701,877/113,448,454 diluted). It is closest to the FY2024 weighted-average diluted share count (105,288,215, from the app's own /fundamentals/ONC/income response for 2024-12-31) — consistent with a stale pre-growth snapshot, since the pack independently confirms ADS count grew materially over the trailing year.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json:207 (fundamentals.body.shares_outstanding = 104271757) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json shares.ordinary_shares_outstanding (value 1478124405, source SEC 10-Q cover) and shares.ads_outstanding_derived (value 113701877); sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:394 (shares_outstanding=_num(info.get("sharesOutstanding")) — a raw passthrough of yfinance's own field, no cross-check against the filed share count or against the app's own fifty_two_week/market_cap fields); field_meta.shares_outstanding in the collected file (line ~428) is marked status 'ok' with no confidence downgrade despite the value being wrong.
notes: Money-relevant number shown as true with full confidence, feeding downstream ratios (market_cap, per-share calcs) — market_cap itself is consequently ~0.51% low ($39.69bn app vs $39.89bn cross-checked outside truth, docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/diffs/P18_ONC.json field 'market_cap'). Root cause: sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:394 trusts yfinance's sharesOutstanding field verbatim with no plausibility check against the same provider's own filed-shares or ADS-ratio data. Smallest fix: sanity-check shares_outstanding against a bundled/filed reference count (or at minimum flag field_meta status when the value implies a market cap that diverges >X% from price x shares computed independently) rather than trusting a single upstream field silently.

title: ONC insider and institutional ownership percentages (the US nearest-equivalent to Indian promoter/institutional holding, the mandatory subtle-tier check) diverge sharply from outside truth — insider ownership overstated ~4.2x, institutional ownership understated by ~20 points
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/ONC -> held_percent_insiders=0.17277001 (17.28%), held_percent_institutions=0.33159 (33.16%). Outside truth (stockanalysis.com, aggregating SEC Forms 3/4/5 + the proxy table for insiders and 13F filings for institutions, as_of 2026-09-18): insider_ownership_pct=4.1%, institutional_ownership_pct=52.86%. Same field, same definition (percentage of shares held by insiders / institutions), same as-of window — insiders shown 4.2x too high, institutions shown ~20 percentage points (37% relative) too low, and the pack notes the 52.86% figure is itself already an UNDERSTATEMENT (13F only covers US-registered managers, so true institutional holding is higher still, widening the app's gap further).
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json:211-212 (held_percent_insiders, held_percent_institutions) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json shareholding.insider_ownership_pct and shareholding.institutional_ownership_pct (both sourced https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/statistics/, as_of 2026-09-18); sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:398-399 (held_percent_insiders=_num(info.get("heldPercentInsiders")), held_percent_institutions=_num(info.get("heldPercentInstitutions")) — raw yfinance passthrough, field_meta marks both 'ok' with no cross-check).
notes: This is the mandatory shareholding/promoter-equivalent subtle-tier check called out by name in PROMPT_data_s2.md as 'the single most gameable number' class of field. For a US ADS-structured issuer this is a known yfinance weak spot: heldPercentInsiders is frequently computed off Form 3/4/5 filings against the ORDINARY share count while the company's public float is measured in ADS units (13:1 ratio) — a plausible root cause for exactly this kind of multi-x distortion, though the precise yfinance-internal computation was not opened (out of scope: third-party library internals). Root-cause-agnostic fix inside this codebase: sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:398-399 should either cross-check against a second source or degrade field_meta confidence for held_percent_* on ADS-structured names rather than serving it as 'ok' with full confidence.

title: ONC dividend_per_share_ttm always renders as 'unavailable' via the yfinance provider even though the true value is a well-determined, documented zero (company has never paid a dividend)
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/ONC -> dividend_per_share_ttm=null, field_meta.dividend_per_share_ttm={status:'unavailable', reason:'provider did not publish this field'}. Outside truth (stockanalysis.com, as_of 2026-09-18): paid_trailing_12m_per_share=0 USD/ADS, explicitly printed as a determinate value (the company has never declared or paid a dividend), distinct from dividend.yield which the same source correctly prints as 'n/a' rather than a coerced 0.00%.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json (fundamentals.body.dividend_per_share_ttm=null and its field_meta entry) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json dividend.paid_trailing_12m_per_share (value 0, source https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/); sidecar/models/fundamentals.py:111 (dividend_per_share_ttm: float | None = None is a defined model field); sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:175 ('dividend_per_share_ttm' appears only in a field list, never assigned from any info.get(...) call anywhere in the file) — the field is structurally unpopulatable by this provider for every symbol, not merely for ONC.
notes: The Indian-mandatory diff instruction explicitly requires treating 'declared vs paid dividends' as two distinct facts — this is the paid-trailing-12m half, and the app collapses a real, knowable answer (0) into the same 'unavailable' bucket it would use for a stock where the true 12m-paid figure genuinely could not be determined. A user cannot distinguish 'this company has never paid a dividend' from 'we could not fetch dividend data' from the field_meta reason string alone. Smallest fix: derive dividend_per_share_ttm=0 when dividendRate/dividendYield are both confirmed-absent on a provider that reliably reports non-payers as null (rather than leaving the field permanently unpopulated), or at minimum give the field_meta reason a distinguishable label ('no dividend history' vs 'provider gap').

title: Identity enrichment (ISIN, former company name, listing board/tier, original listing date) is India-only by design and silently stays null for a resolved non-Indian instrument even when the real value is one HTTP fetch away
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/resolve?q=ONC -> resolved.isin=null, resolved.former_name=null, resolved.bse_code=null (correctly null — not an Indian security) and there is no board/listing_date field anywhere in the resolve or fundamentals schema at all. Outside truth for ONC: isin=US07725L1026 (stockanalysis.com), former_name='BeiGene, Ltd.' renamed 2025-05-27 (SEC EDGAR submissions record), board='The Nasdaq Global Select Market (mainboard tier)' (10-Q cover), listing_date=2016-02-02 (original Nasdaq IPO under BGNE, Wikipedia) — all readily fetchable, none of which the app surfaces for this or, by the code's own docstring, ANY non-Indian instrument.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json:19-31 (resolved.isin/former_name/bse_code all null) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json identity.isin, identity.former_names, identity.board, identity.listing_date; sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:855-871 (_enrich_instrument docstring: 'A field the bundled data does not carry stays None — a group-X micro-cap... never an invented sector. Idempotent: returns the same object when nothing to add (US tickers, or an already-enriched instrument)') and :877-878 (if inst.exchange not in ("NSE", "BSE"): return inst — enrichment is hard-gated to Indian exchanges only, by design).
notes: This is a deliberate, documented scoping decision (the docstring names 'US tickers' explicitly), not an accidental bug — so it is a real product-completeness gap rather than a silent defect: for a product whose stated benchmark is screener.in-grade density for 'any listed stock, however obscure' and whose moat claim is data trust/density, a US biotech with active SEC filings gets materially thinner identity metadata than an Indian small-cap, even though the sources (SEC EDGAR, aggregators) are no harder to reach than the BSE master already bundled for Indian names. Smallest fix shape: extend a lightweight non-Indian identity join (ISIN via a known aggregator page, board/listing_date from a one-time SEC/exchange lookup cached like the BSE master) rather than hard-gating enrichment to exchange in (NSE, BSE).

title: ONC forward P/E diverges ~22.5% from outside truth with no disclosed estimate provenance on either side
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/ONC -> forward_pe=34.004196. Outside truth (stockanalysis.com, as_of 2026-09-18): forward_pe=43.91 — same field (price / forward EPS consensus), same as-of window, a ~22.5% relative gap (app's figure implies a materially higher forward-EPS consensus than the outside source's).
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json:183 (fundamentals.body.forward_pe=34.004196) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json pe_ttm.forward_pe (value 43.91, source https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/); sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:367 (forward_pe=_num(info.get("forwardPE")) — raw yfinance passthrough with no disclosed consensus-panel source and no field_meta note that this is estimate-derived rather than a filed fact).
notes: Per PROMPT_data_s2.md's collector guidance, two good sources disagreeing on a same-definition field is itself the finding, not something to smooth over — forward P/E is unlike ROCE/ROIC (where the pack explicitly documents multiple legitimate bases); here both sides compute the identical ratio, they just draw on different analyst-consensus panels, and the app discloses neither its own source panel nor that this is an estimate (vs the filed, checkable pe_ttm). Smallest fix: label forward-looking fields with their consensus source/vintage in field_meta so a user can tell an estimate-derived number from a filed one and knows which panel it reflects.

title: Disclosures endpoints (shareholding, announcements, results-calendar) are hardcoded NSE/BSE-only and 502 for every non-Indian symbol, losing real, readily-available corporate-actions and filing data for a US name like ONC
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/disclosures/shareholding?symbol=ONC, /disclosures/announcements?symbol=ONC&limit=25, and /disclosures/results?symbol=ONC all return HTTP 502 with "disclosures: 'ONC' is not a known NSE/BSE instrument" / "nse_direct: 'ONC' is not a known NSE instrument". Outside truth for the same 2026 window: 6 real corporate actions (AGM share/buyback mandates, equity-plan pool increase, board reconstitution, S-8 and S-3ASR filings, a ~RMB446M China tax settlement), a Q2 2026 10-Q filed 2026-08-05, and 3 recent SEC filings including a 2026-09-16 13D/A — none of it surfaced anywhere in the app for this symbol.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P18_ONC.json:2477-2512 (shareholding/announcements/results_calendar calls, all status 502) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P18_ONC.json corporate_actions_2026, latest_results, last_3_announcements; sidecar/services/corporate_disclosures.py:393 (raise ProviderError(f"disclosures: {bare!r} is not a known NSE/BSE instrument")); sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:359 (same NSE-only gate for the results-calendar route).
notes: The 502 is an honest, correctly-worded error (not a silent null), which lowers this from a data-trust violation to a coverage gap — but the net effect for a user researching a US holding is the same: zero corporate-actions/filings visibility, where a real feed (SEC EDGAR 8-K/10-Q/13D filings, fetched directly for this pack with no special tooling) exists and is not wired in. Given the product's stated cross-market ambition, this is the single largest data-completeness gap found for this slot. Smallest fix shape: a minimal SEC-EDGAR-backed disclosures provider for US symbols (submissions API + recent 8-K/10-Q index, mirroring what the pack collector already does by hand) behind the same /disclosures/* routes, rather than leaving non-Indian symbols entirely unserved.
